# Weekly Docker cleanup script
# - Checks docker is available and responsive
# - Logs output to $HOME/.local/share/docker-cleanup/
# - Runs a full system prune (containers, images, networks, volumes)
set -euo pipefail

LOG_DIR="${HOME:-/root}/.local/share/docker-cleanup"
mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"
LOG_FILE="$LOG_DIR/cleanup-$(date +%F).log"

  echo "docker: command not found. Aborting cleanup." >> "$LOG_FILE"

if ! docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "docker: daemon not responding. Aborting cleanup." >> "$LOG_FILE"
  exit 0
fi

echo "docker system prune -af --volumes (this will remove unused containers, images, networks, and volumes)" >> "$LOG_FILE"
# Run prune; capture output but do not cause script to exit on non-zero (keep set -e for other failures)
docker system prune -af --volumes >> "$LOG_FILE" 2>&1 || true

echo "=== Docker cleanup finished at $(date) ===" >> "$LOG_FILE""}
